answer: The defence rests on thesis examination record with university viva logs: vivas examined for one university across years. Forging 243 of these means building 243 separate viva logs from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. The raven test is the price tag: 243 fakes mean 243 payments. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The summit signal is visible to every grader, and the plume ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
